risks.risk: Model/series unknown → wrong pricing tier (a “professional” claim can’t be verified without the exact model).
risks.proof: A clear photo of the model/serial label (usually back/bottom) and any model text on the front panel if present.
risks.if_unproven: Price at worst-case for an unidentified Yamaha keyboard (do not assume higher-end “professional”).

risks.risk: Functionality risk (dead keys/crackling/intermittent sound) cannot be confirmed remotely without a test recording.
risks.proof: Short video: power on + screen/menu working + play across full keyboard range + press key controls; include audio of sustained notes and a few button presses.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully proven (worst case: treat as needing service/possible faults).

risks.risk: Adapter/charger may be missing or incorrect (UK plug/voltage).
risks.proof: Photo of the exact adapter/charger included showing label specs; video of powering on using it.
risks.if_unproven: Price as adapter not guaranteed (worst case: buyer must source correct adapter).

risks.risk: Hidden cosmetic/physical damage (cracked casing, damaged speaker area, loose knobs) not fully visible in the provided angles.
risks.proof: Photos of back panel, bottom, close-ups of knobs/buttons, and speaker grille condition; photo of any serial label.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming used condition with possible cosmetic wear.

proof_requests: Send a clear photo of the model/serial label (back or bottom) so the exact Yamaha model can be identified.
Send a short video test with audio: power on + screen/menu + play left-to-right across all keys + press several buttons/controls.
Send a photo of the adapter/charger included (label specs) and a quick video showing the keyboard powering on with it.
response.reason: The seller’s reply is not supported by new evidence. Without a readable model and without a functional/audio test and adapter photo, pricing in Abuja can’t be done confidently, so we must request proof.
